releaseNotes:
- Per-file upload budget from size with idle-stall watchdog for large files
- Phased upload: small files first, large files with your worker count + single-worker retry
- Unified byte-volume progress bar (total MB live during large uploads)
- Fixes: false missing-on-server verify, Overwrite vs Crash Recovery skip, FTP folder-named-like-file (550), worker count on large files, clear FTP errors, unified progress UI, partial directory cleanup
